accepted_patches.summary: Bind HUMAN_AUDIT_REQUIRED to suspended_from origin; allow READY_TO_MERGE only when origin == PROOF_ASSEMBLED with CompleteProofReceiptPackage.
Allow EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE -> SANDBOX_EXECUTING only when origin is in {CHANGE_ADMITTED..PROOF_ASSEMBLED}; otherwise return to origin.
Allow recovery from BREAK_GLASS_ACTIVE via RealignmentProjectionReceipt to GENESIS_LOCKED or new child run.
Define ANY_ACTIVE_STATE explicitly and enforce deterministic exception precedence.
Route ROLLED_BACK from genesis states to GENESIS_MORPHING instead of INTENT_CAPTURED.
Enforce both InitializedWorkspace and ValidatedIntentContract on GENESIS_LOCKED -> INTENT_CAPTURED.
Record pre-journal genesis transitions as retroactive entries (seq 0..k) backed by blueprint and user approval hashes.
Require CompensatingActionReceipt for post-merge rollback instead of WorktreeCleanupReceipt.
Add HANDSHAKE_PENDING rejection (-> CONTRACT_DRAFTING) and timeout (-> INTENT_CAPTURED) transitions.
Add BREAK_GLASS_ACTIVE -> GENESIS_LOCKED transition guarded by RealignmentProjectionReceipt.
Use polymorphic abstract proof labels ArchetypeSecurityScanProof and ArchetypePerformanceScanProof.
Route POST_DEPLOY_OBSERVING drift detection via AutomatedPatchProposal to INTENT_CAPTURED without direct live mutation.
Enforce triple RED acceptance oracle on TESTS_ARMED_RED: CompilationSuccess == TRUE, RuntimeExecution == EXECUTED, TestExitCode != 0.
Forbid direct merge after QUARANTINED; require return to INTENT_CAPTURED after human security audit.
